tools.description: Fetches Eredivisie standings for a given season using the RapidAPI service.

season.description: The season for which to fetch the standings, e.g., '2022'. Defaults to None.

tools.name: stagedetails
tools.description: Fetch the details of a specific Motorsport stage using the provided stage ID.

stageid.description: The ID of the Motorsport stage for which to retrieve the details.

tools.name: daily_match_list_scheduled
tools.description: Retrieves the list of scheduled basketball matches for a given date.

date.description: The date for which to retrieve scheduled matches in the format 'dd/MM/yyyy'. Data can be retrieved for a period of ± 7 days from the current date.

query: Get the details of the YouTube channels 'UC8butISFwT-Wl7EV0hUK0BQ' and 'UC-lHJZR3Gqxm24_Vd_AJ5Yw', and also provide the information about the domains 'google.com' and 'facebook.com'.

tools.name: channel_details
tools.description: Fetches details of a YouTube channel given its ID and desired parts using the RapidAPI service.

is_id.description: The ID of the YouTube channel to fetch details for.

part.description: The part parameter specifies a comma-separated list of one or more channel resource properties that the API response will include.

tools.name: whois
tools.description: Queries a WhoIS lookup service to retrieve data about a specified domain.

domain.description: The domain name for the WhoIS lookup.

tools.name: top_paid_ipad_apps
tools.description: Gets a list of the top paid iPad apps from the specified category and country.

category.description: The App Store category for which to fetch the top paid iPad apps. Defaults to '6016'.

country.description: The country code for which to fetch the top paid iPad apps. Defaults to 'us'.

lang.description: The language code for the response. Defaults to 'en'.

num.description: The number of results to return. Defaults to 100.

query: Can you fetch the info for the hashtag challenge named 'DanceChallenge2023'? I need it for my project.

tools.name: hashtag_data_by_name
tools.description: Fetches data for a specified TikTok hashtag using the given challenge name.

challenge_name.description: The name of the TikTok hashtag challenge to retrieve data for.

tools.name: get_individual_result_by_id
tools.description: Fetches individual result data by a given ID from the Robbery Data API.

is_id.description: The ID of the individual whose result data is to be fetched.

tools.name: profile
tools.description: Fetches and returns the profile information of a given Instagram user using the specified RapidAPI key.

ig.description: The Instagram username for which the profile information is to be retrieved.

tools.name: user_medias
tools.description: Fetches media posts for a specified Instagram user.

user_id.description: The Instagram user ID for which to fetch media posts.

next_max_id.description: Pagination parameter for fetching the next set of media posts. Default is None.

query: Can you calculate the resistance of an aluminum wire that's 300 meters long with a cross-sectional area of 0.006 square meters? Also, how many years does it take for light to travel 25 light years?

tools.name: light_travel_time
tools.description: Calculate the time taken for light to travel from one celestial body to another.

distance_in_light_years.description: The distance between the two celestial bodies in light years.

speed_of_light.description: The speed of light in vacuum, in m/s. Default value is 299792458 m/s.

tools.name: wire_resistance
tools.description: Calculates the resistance of a wire based on its length, cross-sectional area, and material resistivity.

length_m.description: The length of the wire in meters.

area_sq_m.description: The cross-sectional area of the wire in square meters.

material.description: The material of the wire. Allowed values: "copper" (default) or "aluminum".

query: What are the DNS records for apple.com and can you fetch the content from their support page?

tools.name: get_content
tools.description: Retrieves the content from the given URL using the RapidAPI service.

url.description: The URL of the webpage from which to extract content.

tools.name: dns
tools.description: Fetches DNS records for a given domain using the RapidAPI domain checker service.

domain.description: The domain for which DNS records are to be retrieved.

query: What are the car models offered by Tesla? What are the top suggestions for places near Palo Alto, California?

tools.name: get_car_models
tools.description: Fetches all car models for a specified car maker using the InfoCars API.

maker.description: The name of the car maker to fetch the models for.

tools.name: autocomplete
tools.description: Fetches autocomplete suggestions for places, locations, and addresses using the Waze API.

lang.description: The language of the results. Defaults to 'en'. Refer to https://wazeopedia.waze.com/wiki/USA/Countries_and_Languages for a list of supported languages.

coordinates.description: Geographic coordinates (latitude, longitude) to bias the results. Defaults to '37.376754, -122.023350'. Recommended for getting accurate results.

query: What is the bacterial population after 90 minutes, given an initial population of 2000 bacteria, a growth rate of 0.1, and a doubling time of 40 minutes? Also, generate the first 30 Fibonacci numbers.

tools.name: bacterial_growth
tools.description: Calculates the bacterial population after a given time based on the initial population and growth rate.

growth_rate.description: The growth rate per unit time.

doubling_time.description: The doubling time of the bacteria in minutes. Defaults to 20.

tools.name: fibonacci_numbers
tools.description: Generates the first n Fibonacci numbers.

n.description: The number of Fibonacci numbers to generate.

tools.name: mean_confidence_interval
tools.description: Calculates the confidence interval for a sample mean.

std_dev.description: The standard deviation of the sample.

confidence.description: The desired confidence level. Default is 0.95.

tools.name: find_peak_element
tools.description: Finds a peak element in a list of integers.

query: List all available cryptocurrency symbols.

tools.name: type_parent_get_recent_investment_rating_change
tools.description: Fetches the recent investment rating change as displayed in the Parent tab for a given security.

type.description: The type of security, either 'etf' or 'fund'.

securityid.description: The security ID used to query the investment rating change.

tools.name: estimates
tools.description: Retrieves estimates for a specified stock symbol using the Holistic Finance API.

symbol.description: The stock symbol for which to retrieve estimates.

tools.name: crypto_symbols
tools.description: Returns a list of all available cryptocurrencies from the RapidAPI service.

includenames.description: If True, include cryptocurrency names in the response. Defaults to None.

query: Find all .jpg files in the directory '/home/user/pictures'. Also, find the first non-repeating character in the string 'racecar'.

tools.name: find_missing_ranges
tools.description: Finds the missing ranges between lower and upper in a sorted list of integers.

tools.name: binary_search
tools.description: Performs binary search on a sorted list to find the index of a target value.

target.description: The target value to search for.

tools.name: find_max_subarray_sum
tools.description: Finds the maximum sum of a contiguous subarray within a list of integers.

tools.name: is_palindrome
tools.description: Checks if a string is a palindrome.

tools.name: find_files
tools.description: Finds all files with a specific extension in a directory and its subdirectories.

extension.description: The file extension to search for.

tools.name: find_first_non_repeating_char
tools.description: Finds the first non-repeating character in a string.

query: Update the financial records with the transaction details: transaction ID 'T1234', amount '1000.00', and currency 'USD'.

tools.name: update
tools.description: Updates data on a specified endpoint using the provided information and RapidAPI key.

info3.description: The third piece of information to be sent as a query parameter.

info1.description: The first piece of information to be sent as a query parameter.

info2.description: The second piece of information to be sent as a query parameter.

query: I'm curious about the music trends in Australia on Spotify, could you possibly look that up?

tools.name: get_home_page_overview
tools.description: Fetches trending information displayed on the Spotify home page as an incognito visitor.

region.description: Region code (ISO 3166 alpha-2) for localized results. Defaults to `None`, which will fallback to `US` if unsupported.

query: I need to know the holidays in São Paulo state for the year 2022. Additionally, what are the non-working days in the USA for the same year?

tools.name: get_1_3_list_non_working_days
tools.description: Fetch the non-working days (weekend days, public holidays, and custom dates) between two specified dates for a given country.

start_date.description: The start date in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

end_date.description: The end date in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

country_code.description: The ISO country code (2 letters). See available countries & configurations.

configuration.description: The name of the preset configuration to be used. Defaults to 'Federal holidays'.

profile_id.description: Custom profile ID for the request. Defaults to None.

tools.name: get_hebrew_month
tools.description: Fetches the Hebrew month for a given Gregorian date string using the Enoch Calendar API.

datestring.description: The Gregorian date in 'YYYY-MM-DD' format for which to get the Hebrew month.

tools.name: feriados_dos_estados
tools.description: Retrieves the holidays for a given Brazilian state and year.

estado.description: Abbreviation of the Brazilian state in uppercase letters.

ano.description: Year for which to retrieve the holidays.

query: What are the trending topics on Twitter in London, and retrieve data for the company with LinkedIn URL 'https://www.linkedin.com/company/google/'?

tools.name: trend_id
tools.description: Fetches trending topics from Twitter based on a given "Where On Earth IDentifier" (WOEID) using the Toolbench RapidAPI service.

woeid.description: The Yahoo! Where On Earth IDentifier (WOEID) for which to get trending topics.

tools.name: get_company_data_by_linkedin_url
tools.description: Fetch company data using a given LinkedIn URL via the ToolBench RapidAPI.

linkedin_url.description: The LinkedIn URL of the company to retrieve data for.

tools.name: draw_date_listing
tools.description: Fetches a listing of Thai lottery draw dates from the RapidAPI service.

page.description: The page number of the results to fetch. Defaults to 1.

tools.name: retrieving_assets
tools.description: Retrieve a list of assets from the OpenSea API with various filter parameters.

owner.description: The wallet address of the owner of the assets. Default is None.

order_direction.description: The order of the results. Can be 'asc' or 'desc'. Default is 'desc'.

asset_contract_address.description: The contract address for the assets. Default is None.

limit.description: The number of assets to return. Default is 20.

collection_slug.description: The collection slug to filter assets. Default is None.

cursor.description: A cursor to paginate results. Default is None.

token_ids.description: Specific token IDs to filter assets. Default is None.

asset_contract_addresses.description: Specific contract addresses to filter assets. Default is None.

collection.description: The collection name to filter assets. Default is 'ongakucraft'.

include_orders.description: Whether to include order information for the assets. Default is None.

collection_editor.description: The editor of the collection to filter assets. Default is None.
